import sys, json, random, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
random.seed(12345)
def rnd_wire(n):
    return bytes(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(n))
def rnd_envelope():
    kind=random.randrange(6)
    if kind==0: return rnd_wire(random.randrange(0,40))
    if kind==1:  # plausible long header
        first=random.choice([0xc0,0xc1,0xc2,0xc3,0xe0,0xe1,0xe2,0xe3,0xd0,0xb0])
        cid=random.choice([b'\xaa',b'\xbb',b'\xcc',b'',bytes(range(20))])
        scid=random.choice([b'\xbb',b'',bytes(range(10))])
        tok=random.choice([b'',b'\x01\x02',bytes(30)])
        pn=random.randrange(0,256)
        body=rnd_wire(random.randrange(0,12))
        w=random.choice([1,2,4])
        ln=random.choice([w+len(body), w+len(body), 0, w+len(body)+3])
        tl=len(tok)
        tlw=random.choice([1,2])
        def v(x,w):
            if w==1: return bytes([x]) if x<64 else b'\x40'+x.to_bytes(2,'big')[1:]
            return ((1<<(8*w-2))|x).to_bytes(w,'big')
        return bytes([first])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([len(cid)])+cid+bytes([len(scid)])+scid+v(tl,tlw)+tok+v(ln,w if random.random()<0.5 else 8 if ln>1073741823 else (2 if ln>16383 else 1))+pn.to_bytes(w,'big')+body
    if kind==2:  # plausible short header
        first=random.choice([0x40,0x41,0x42,0x43,0x44,0x45,0x46,0x47,0x60,0x61,0x50,0x00,0x80])
        cid=random.choice([b'\xaa',b'\xbb',b'\xcc'])
        w=random.choice([1,2,4])
        return bytes([first])+cid+random.randrange(0,256).to_bytes(w,'big')+rnd_wire(random.randrange(0,10))
    if kind==3:  # frame soup in an A packet
        frames=b''
        for _ in range(random.randrange(1,4)):
            t=random.choice([b'\x00',b'\x01',b'\x02',b'\x06',b'\x08',b'\x0b',b'\x0c',b'\x0e',b'\x10',b'\x11',b'\x12',b'\x14',b'\x15',b'\x18',b'\x19',b'\x1a',b'\x1c',b'\x1d',b'\x30',b'\x31',b'\x20',b'\x40'])
            frames+=t+rnd_wire(random.randrange(0,8))
        return bytes([0x40])+b'\xaa'+b'\x00'+frames
    if kind==4: return b''
    return rnd_wire(random.randrange(0,3))
traces=[]
for _ in range(40):
    events=[]
    for _ in range(random.randrange(0,12)):
        if random.random()<0.25:
            events.append({'keys':random.sample(['I','H','A'],random.randrange(0,4))})
        else:
            auth=[random.choice([None,0,1,2,3]) for _ in range(random.randrange(0,5))]
            events.append({'datagram':{'wire':rnd_envelope().hex(),'auth':auth}})
    traces.append({'limits':{'connection':random.choice([0,5,4611686018427387903]),'stream':random.choice([0,3,4611686018427387903]),
                             'bidi':random.choice([0,2,1152921504606846976]),'uni':random.choice([0,2,1152921504606846976]),
                             'cids':random.choice([2,3,4])},
                   'local':{'bidi':random.choice([0,1,2]),'uni':random.choice([0,2]),'cids':random.choice([['aa','bb'],['aa'],['0000','0001','0002','0003'],['aa','bb','cc','dd','ee','ff']])},
                   'peer':{'cid':'cc','token':'00'*16},
                   'received':{'I':random.choice([None,0,5,4611686018427387903]),'H':random.choice([None,2]),'A':random.choice([None,0,7])},
                   'events':events})
data=json.dumps({'traces':traces}).encode()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True)
print('exit',p.returncode,'stderr',p.stderr.decode()[:400])
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('traces',len(out.get('traces',[])), 'statuses', sum(len(t['packets']) for t in out.get('traces',[])))
